description: This file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Hook API in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting hooks.

classes.name: HookApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for hook API requests and responses.

classes.name: PostHookRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new hook.

classes.name: PostHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a hook.

classes.name: GetHookTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving hook templates and groupings.

classes.name: DeleteHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after deleting a hook.

classes.name: PutHookRequest
classes.description: Schema for updating an existing hook.

classes.name: PutHookResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after updating a hook, including change details.
